MeshStatsViewer.SurfaceAreaTooltip: Total area of all mesh surfaces.
MeshStatsViewer.VertexCountTooltip: Number of vertices used by the mesh.
MeshStatsViewer.TrisCountTooltip: Total number of tris in the mesh.
MeshStatsViewer.TrisDensityTooltip: Triangle count relative to the model's size or surface area.
MeshStatsViewer.TrisReductionTooltip: Percentage of tris removed from the original mesh.
MeshStatsViewer.NoLODButSmall: Mesh is small and does not necessarily need to have LODs.
MeshStatsViewer.MinimalLODReduction: LODs provide very little triangle reduction.
MeshStatsViewer.HighTrisDensity: Mesh geometry is dense relative to its size.
MeshStatsViewer.ComplexSmallMesh: Small mesh contains a high amount of geometry.
MeshStatsViewer.StarQ_Option.DetailedVie: Show detailed information about the mesh on the Selected Info Panel.
MeshStatsViewer.StarQ_Option.LOD1Thresho: Set the tris reduction threshold for LOD1 used to display the warning symbol. (Default 50%)
MeshStatsViewer.StarQ_Option.LOD2Thresho: Set the tris reduction threshold for LOD2 used to display the warning symbol. (Default 80%)
MeshStatsViewer.StarQ_Option.TrisThresho: Set the tris threshold used to determine whether a mesh is high-density or requires LODs. (Default 5,000)
MeshStatsViewer.StarQ_Option.VolumeThres: Set the volume threshold used to determine whether a mesh is considered small. (Default 1m³)
